entity.name: AUTOM8 LLC (Zovo)
entity.description: Zovo is a bootstrapped software product studio that builds and sells privacy-first Chrome extensions and local-first developer tools. The studio is owned and run by Michael Lip, a Polish engineer and EU citizen. Michael Lip is the sole maintainer. Zovo has raised no outside money and is funded by the founder's own engineering work and product sales. Products live at https://zovo.one and the source is published under OSI licences at https://github.com/theluckystrike. The funding requested here pays for maintenance and new releases of the two open source projects below, so the free tiers stay free and the code stays public.

projects.name: Zovo MCP servers
projects.description: A collection of 54 local-first Model Context Protocol servers for everyday back-office work: invoices, VAT, PDFs, spreadsheets, Word documents, time tracking and expenses. Each server runs locally over stdio and keeps the user's data on their own machine. 45 of the servers are also reachable as a hosted endpoint at https://mcp.zovo.one. The code is MIT licensed. The project is maintained by one developer. Funding would pay for maintenance, new servers, tests across client versions and user documentation.

projects.name: Tab Suspender for Chrome
projects.description: An open source Manifest V3 Chrome extension that suspends inactive tabs to free memory. It runs with no tracking and no telemetry. The popup's manual suspension path currently bypasses allowlist, pinned-tab and audio checks. The unsaved-form protection setting currently does not affect the background suspension decision. The code is MIT licensed and every line is inspectable in the repository. Zovo's Chrome Web Store build ships from a separate codebase. Its user count does not establish adoption of this MIT repository. Funding would pay for maintenance against Chrome platform changes, regression tests and accessibility work, so a free tab suspender without trackers stays available to users.

channels.description: Direct bank transfer to AUTOM8 LLC, the entity behind Zovo. E-mail support@zovo.one and the receiving account details are sent back.

plans.name: Open source maintenance 2026
plans.description: One year of maintenance for both projects covers platform fixes, regression tests, accessibility and docs. Michael Lip is the only paid person. No hardware, travel or subcontractors. Pending requests seek $3,000 from FUTO for 60 hours on a standalone offline PDF core and direct CLI, and $500 from Encrata for an eight-hour Tab Suspender form-guard pass. Those hours and deliverables are excluded from this $10,000 plan; no work is funded twice. Neither request has a confirmed award.
